allowed_evidence_spans: Infection with HIV cannot currently be cured; however it can be controlled by combination treatment with multiple anti-retroviral drugs .

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: Computational models help predict optimal drug combinations for individual patients.
evidence_rows.core_keep_af: Because HIV genotypes vary between individual patients, computational models are used to predict the most effective drug combination for a specific patient.
evidence_rows.expert_summary_hint: The optimal combination of drugs depends on the specific strain of HIV with which the patient is infected.
evidence_rows.lay_context: Because the virus mutates differently in every person, doctors need tools to match the right drugs to a patient's specific viral genetic makeup (genotype).
allowed_evidence_spans: With the availability of viral genotypic data and clinical phenotypic data , it has become possible to create computational models able to predict an optimal treatment regimen for an individual patient .

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: Current models ignore the chemical similarity of drugs.
evidence_rows.core_keep_af: Existing HIV drug resistance models typically rely only on viral sequence data and do not account for the chemical similarity of the drugs.
evidence_rows.expert_summary_hint: Previously, methods have been developed that predict a personalized treatment regimen based on the genetic sequence (genotype) of the virus.
evidence_rows.lay_context: Older computer models only looked at the virus's genes, ignoring how similar different drugs are to one another chemically.
allowed_evidence_spans: Current models are based only on sequence data derived from viral genotyping; chemical similarity of drugs is not considered .
forbidden_overgeneralizations: chemical similarity is the only factor

evidence_rows.abstract_claim: Proteochemometric models combine drug chemistry and protein target properties.

evidence_rows.expert_summary_hint: Proteochemometric modeling takes this genetic information into account, but also includes chemical description of the drugs.
evidence_rows.lay_context: This new approach, called proteochemometric (PCM) modeling, looks at both the virus's proteins and the chemical structure of the drugs at the same time.
